scoring_justification: T0: result-level compare; re-running MD is infeasible in verifier sandbox, so checker reads agent-reported CSV files and compares to paper-reported asymptotic values and structural trends (monotonicity, sign of stress).

hidden_assets.purpose: target asymptotic elastic modulus and Poisson's ratio from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and Fig.6: E→208.0 GPa for d≳6 nm, ν→0.355 by d≈5 nm.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported convergent limits.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own numbers; they are necessary as a reference to score the reproduction.

outputs.description: Size-dependent axial elastic modulus and Poisson's ratio. The checker will compare to the paper's reported asymptotes and monotonic trends.
Cross-sectional normal stress profile at free relaxation. The checker will verify tensile near surface and compressive near centre.

steps.description: Check monotonic trends (E decreasing, nu increasing) and asymptotic convergence to paper values.
Verify tensile near surface, compressive (or zero) near centre, and physically reasonable magnitude.
